svg.title: The region where ani's degree-seven polynomial has modulus below 1: seven hatched petals inside the unit circle, one zero in each, with the zeros A and B in red, 1.95 apart, joined by red legs through the centre, and the dashed ellipse on which the distances to A and B add up to 2, passing through the centre. Beside it, the disc of radius 1.2 times 10 to the minus 12 about the centre: the arms of A and B meet at a passage just beyond the ellipse, now a dashed line; a small red circle C encloses the passage, and red rays leave it towards A and B. Reaching C from A and from B costs more than 2, so every path joining two zeros is longer than 2.
